ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the schematic diagram of urban land-use distribution in Figure 7, the urban construction land is not concentrated into a single continuous large block, but there is a "central cluster" in the central position, and around it one can also see multiple relatively separated clusters such as the "western cluster," "northern cluster," "eastern cluster," and "southeastern cluster"; these clusters are connected by railways, expressways, and main urban traffic roads. Then reason: if an urban spatial structure unfolds around multiple relatively independent functional clusters or development centers, it belongs to a multi-core structure. There are multiple clusters in the figure, rather than a single core expanding outward evenly, so the spatial structure form of this city presents a multi-core shape.
